thesis: The episode introduces Roxanne Petraeus, co-founder and CEO of Athena, a company that reimagines compliance training to be effective and engaging rather than just a legal checkbox. Petraeus argues that traditional compliance training is often painful, dated, and ineffective, proposing instead a model of digestible, five-minute-a-month content delivered via Slack or email that uses formats like podcasts and comics to actually change behavior.
